text:
morgan: Quick question — as we roll v2, do we add client-version badging in Console to surface tenants still calling v1? I'm worried about routing/quota interactions during the grace window.
ara: +1. We should surface per-route 'compatibility' state and a direct link to the migration guide. Helps SRE + sales. :eyes:
sam: We'll need telemetry first — daily counts of v1 vs v2 requests per tenant and percent of fallbacks. Suggest event names: `api.client_version` + `route.fallback_trigger`.
jin: For routing, prefer soft-fallback behaviour: try v2, fallback to v1 if capacity/latency constraints. For quotas, count against the model actually served to avoid double-billing.
morgan: UX question — should tenants be able to toggle "opt-in to v2" in Console for fast rollouts? Might reduce ops friction.
devex-ellen: Danger: tenant-facing toggles often = support churn. Recommend a 'recommendation' CTA plus an exportable CSV of tenant migration readiness (errors, percent v1 traffic).
morgan: OK. Proposal sketch: Console shows per-tenant badge states: [v2-ready], [v1-locked], [mixed]. Clicking badge opens modal with migration checklist, top failing prompts, and a one-click request to schedule migration. Dashboard filter 'compatibility' shows tenants + top error classes. We'll wire telemetry -> metrics -> dashboard tiles.
sam: Implementation details: add `tenant.meta.client_versions` vector to the admin API, emit metrics `counter api.client_version{tenant,version}` and `gauge tenant.compat_state`. Frontend reads admin API to render badges and list.
deploy-bot: @sam deployed feature branch to staging: refs/heads/compat-badging (staging).
ara: Need to coordinate with quota service — if tenant is "v1-locked" but sends `X-Client-Version: v2`, we should honor header for routing but charge against the served model's quota and emit a `billing.version_mismatch` event for audit.
jin: Edge-case: streaming protocol differences between v1 and v2 (chunk framing) — surface a "behavioral diff" link in the modal so product knows risks. Also add an eval set for regressions.
morgan: Timeline suggestion: probe rollout next week to ~5% of tenants. Canary signals: latency delta, regen rate, function-call failures, user-visible hallucination/regression metrics. I'll draft a short runbook with rollback criteria.
sam: I'll add telemetry events and expose a sandbox endpoint for Console to pull sample traces and a small token-limited replay. Example metric emit (pseudo):
```
metric.increment("api.client_version", { tenant: "t-123", version: "v1" })
metric.increment("route.fallback_trigger", { tenant: "t-123", from: "v2", to: "v1" })
```
devex-ellen: +1. Also ensure the migration guide and common troubleshooting tips are inline next to the badge (not buried). That cuts support cycles.
morgan: Thanks — syncing FRIDAY 11:00am to finalize telemetry contract and UX mocks. @jin @sam @devex-ellen please add 3 bullets to the calendar invite about your responsibilities.
ara: One more note: add a console warning for tenants with >10% fallbacks in the last 24h, and expose an API to bulk opt-in/opt-out for enterprise customers.
morgan: Great call. We'll include that in the runbook. :thumbsup:
__notes: Follow agents.md rules: messages are short Slack-style, include bot message, inline code snippets, emoji. No title field.
